avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer; significantly reduces palbociclib plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently with palbociclib

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxic supplement that may impair liver function and increase palbociclib metabolism via CYP3A4 induction
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; may compromise palbociclib tolerability and efficacy

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 modulation; may alter palbociclib metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for changes in palbociclib efficacy or side effects

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing palbociclib exposure
caution_supplements.action: Inform patient to avoid or use cautiously; separate dosing by several hours if necessary

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition leading to increased palbociclib plasma concentrations and elevated risk of adverse effects including myelosuppression and QT prolongation
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice during treatment

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase palbociclib bioavailability and gastrointestinal absorption variability
caution_foods.action: Take palbociclib consistently with or without food; maintain consistent dietary pattern

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (high intake)
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 induction with excessive consumption
caution_foods.action: Normal dietary intake is acceptable; excessive supplementation should be avoided

monitoring_notes: Monitor complete blood counts regularly as palbociclib causes myelosuppression; assess for QT prolongation risk, especially if combined with other QT-prolonging agents. Counsel patients on strict grapefruit avoidance and review all supplements and herbal products for CYP3A4 interactions.
